issues.issue: N stated as '1059 treated' but the card's own design citation (line 1475) says 1061 patients, an internal inconsistency in enrollment count.

Detail states BLA 'Approved as a priority review... January 7, 2022' but the receipt_date field and cover letter give May 7, 2021; the cited quote refers to a July 6, 2021 filing date, conflating receipt/filing dates.
Summary says BLA 'received May 7, 2021' but its supporting citation states the BLA was 'filed on July 6, 2021'; the received vs filed dates are conflated across the card.
Text labels it 'Breakthrough Therapy Designation' while the verbatim quote says 'Breakthrough Drug Designation'; minor terminology mismatch (BTD grant itself is supported).
AUTOMATED_FLAG on '210' is a false positive — 210 mg is a dose and should be excluded from uncited-number checks; the rate ratio 0.29 (95% CI 0.16, 0.51; p<0.001) is fully supported by citation.
AUTOMATED_FLAG on '550' is a false positive — '550 treated' is directly present in the trial-name citation ('Number treated: 550').
AUTOMATED_FLAG on '52' is a false positive — '52 week' duration is supported by multiple design/nct citations.
AUTOMATED_FLAG on '351' is a false positive — '351(a)' is a statutory section reference (supported by receipt_date citation), not an efficacy/safety figure.
